short_description: A smaller, simpler cousin of T4: the same icosahedral DNA-filled head, but a short, non-contractile tail stub with tiny fibres instead of an extendable injection apparatus. T7 is famous not for its shape but for one enzyme it carries: T7 RNA polymerase, one of the most widely used tools in molecular biology.
